liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Let It Grow, St. Stephen, and The Other One sparkle especially; The Other One is in a class all by itself with many emotions [12][15]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): The first set sequence ending with Stella Blue is called splendid [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-07-18.pre-fm.kbfh.berger.107832.flac16** (recommended): pre-FM broadcast master; 35 songs; 161 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1976-07-18.150982.pre-fm.miller.flying-m-.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 5 [3]
- **gd1976-07-18.150187.pre-fm.miller.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: A line buzz is present but gets quieter and does not interfere with music [4]
- **gd1976-07-18.150770.remastered.miller.flac1644**: pre-FM broadcast master; 27 songs; 204 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd76-07-18.sbd.ferguson.244.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 192 min; rated 4.8/5 by 70 [6]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as having good sound quality; The digital archive version is clear and crisp, unlike the old cassette; The songs slink and slide, showcasing effortless movement by Garcia [8][11][13][16]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: KBFH [1]
- The band returned to theaters after a year and a half break [16]
- The show is considered the best of 1976, surpassing the previous night [12]
- This is arguably the best show of 1976 and one of the best of the 70s [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-07-18.pre-fm.kbfh.berger.107832.flac16**: transferred by Rob Berger; source: Pre FM 7" 1/2 track reel @ 7.5 ips, no nr (Michael Schuncke's reels) [1]. Also: The tapes are actual reels sent by DIR Broadcasting to radio stations [1]
- **gd1976-07-18.150982.pre-fm.miller.flying-m-.flac1644**: source: This is a Flying -M- remaster reducing the buzz and hum with iZotope RX8 advanced [3]
- **gd1976-07-18.150187.pre-fm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 21, 2020; source: (KSAN) Pre-FM > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [4]
- **gd1976-07-18.150770.remastered.miller.flac1644**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 27, 2020; source: (KSAN) Pre-FM > Reel Master > DAT (44.1k) [5]. Also: This is a remastered version of shnid=150187 that fixes previous issues [5]
- **gd76-07-18.sbd.ferguson.244.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]. Also: The recording originates from a KSAN-fm radio broadcast made that night; The listener first heard the show on a late 1970s KSAN broadcast cassette [9][11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Elegant Themes: [The work of his day - The Deadhead Cyclist](https://www.deadheadcyclist.com/2022/10/10/the-work-of-his-day/) [21]
- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [Orpheum Theatre, San Francisco, CA 1192 Market Street, San Francisco, CA: Summer 1976 (plus Live FM Broadcasts Part X)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2016/04/orpheum-theatre-san-francisco-ca-1192.html) [22]
